name: Lewatit VP OC 1065, dry-curve conditional benchmark

evidence.basis: Measured 25 C Lewatit CO2 reference curve with a fitted constant activity shift, measured solid Cp and unary water curve; direct humid coadsorption remains blocked.
evidence.not_for: humid coadsorption validation, steam-assisted TVSA transfer, equilibrium-complete four-hour regeneration, shaped-device prediction, lifetime, CSS, annual production or hardware qualification.

shaped_material.basis: The webapp case supplies 10 kg complete dry shaped resin material.
shaped_material.binder_support: Commercial resin beads are represented as the dry resin solid; no additional binder is added.
shaped_material.particle_geometry: Source measured beads span 0.3-1.2 mm; the shared case particle diameter remains an explicit transfer assumption.

reference_curve.source_locator: Low et al. 2023 supporting information AIF/workbook CO2 adsorption branch, 298.15 K

co2.basis: Measured 25 C reference curve with a fitted constant activity shift. The deployed Q was fit with 353.15 K withheld and 393.15 K included; the declared supported use range ends at 353.15 K. A separate fold trained without 393.15 K fails that holdout and is retained.

water.source_locator: Low et al. 2023 supporting information AIF/workbook H2O adsorption branch, 298.15 K
water.basis: Unary Sips fit to measured 25 C water adsorption points; RMSE 0.231788 mol/kg. This is not direct CO2-water coadsorption.

nitrogen.source_locator: Low et al. 2023 measured 298.15 K N2 points; throughput-zero fit; heat from Table 8

oxygen.source_locator: Low et al. 2023 measured 298.15 K O2 points; throughput-zero fit

kinetics.evidence_status: CO2 adsorption rate is the 298.15 K value from a published 400 ppm Arrhenius LDF fit. Water rate is assumed; hot desorption rate is an explicit mirrored assumption; inert rates are disabled.

co2_reference_curve.locator: supporting information workbook CO2 adsorption branch at 298.15 K

co2_temperature_shift.posthoc_diagnostic_note: The 0.30 mol/kg diagnostic was observed after fitting, is not a predeclared gate, and is not reused from the MIL audit.

deployed_fit.fit_rule: least-squares loading residuals across measured adsorption temperatures except 353.15 K
deployed_fit.support_note: 393.15 K informed the deployed coefficient and was evaluated in-sample, but the declared app support range still ends at 353.15 K. Hot operation is a named scenario, not a validity endorsement.

separate_fold_withholding_393_15K.fit_rule: least-squares loading residuals across measured adsorption temperatures except 393.15 K
separate_fold_withholding_393_15K.note: This failure belongs to Q=68024.53, not the deployed Q=75883.673.

water_curve.class: fitted to measured unary adsorption branch

co2_adsorption_kinetics.locator: preprint Table 1; ln(k0)=4.987 s^-1 and Ea=32.90 kJ/mol

desorption_kinetics.basis: mirrored adsorption rate because hot desorption LDF is not measured

humid_coadsorption.reason: Published direct CO2 enhancement/diminution with water cannot be represented by independent unary laws; the shared coadsorption adapter remains a future bounded extension.

assumptions: The 25 C measured curve is the reference; a single effective isosteric heat is fitted to dry adsorption data.

The deployed Q=75883.673 fit withheld 353.15 K (RMSE 0.175198 mol/kg) and includes 393.15 K in fitting. Its 393.15 K in-sample RMSE is 0.255664 mol/kg. These are posthoc diagnostics, not a predeclared acceptance test.
A separate Q=68024.53 fold withheld 393.15 K and failed at RMSE 0.4464 mol/kg; that failed fit is preserved and is not attributed to the deployed Q.
The app's declared supported dry use range ends at 353.15 K even though 393.15 K informed the deployed fit. Hot operation remains a named extrapolation scenario.
The unary water Sips law is a bounded fit and does not reproduce direct water-CO2 coadsorption.
Water kinetics and hot desorption kinetics are explicit assumptions; the 25 C CO2 adsorption LDF value is not transferred as measured hot desorption.
The source bead diameter range and shared case geometry differ; no shaped-device transfer is validated.

validity.co2_dry_equilibrium: Deployed Q=75883.673 has a 353.15 K holdout diagnostic and an in-sample 393.15 K diagnostic; neither is formal acceptance. A different lower-temperature-trained fold failed its 393.15 K holdout. The supported use range ends at 353.15 K and hot use is named extrapolation. No model-ready or universal-validity claim follows.
validity.water: Unary adsorption-branch fit only; no direct humid coadsorption.
validity.regeneration: Hot desorption kinetics, equilibrium closure and steam-assisted operation are not validated. The four-hour pilot regeneration is not assumed equilibrium-complete.
validity.initial_state_interpretation: The app's declared initial state is a scenario, not CSS.

uncertainty.statement: The source reports CO2 td-Toth and water limiting-heat uncertainty; this constrained adapter does not propagate all source uncertainties. The deployed-Q 393.15 K in-sample error and the separate failed 393.15 K holdout are material to hot-cycle interpretation.
